params.name: tags
params.description: List of tags to filter blocks by

params.name: match_all_tags
params.description: If True, only returns blocks that match ALL given tags. Otherwise, return blocks that have ANY of the passed-in tags.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of blocks to return

params.name: before
params.description: Block ID cursor for pagination. Returns blocks that come before this block ID in the specified sort order

params.name: after
params.description: Block ID cursor for pagination. Returns blocks that come after this block ID in the specified sort order

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for blocks by creation time. 'asc' for oldest first, 'desc' for newest first

params.name: order_by
params.description: Field to sort by

params.name: label_search
params.description: Search blocks by label. If provided, returns blocks whose label matches the search query. This is a full-text search on block labels.

params.name: description_search
params.description: Search blocks by description. If provided, returns blocks whose description matches the search query. This is a full-text search on block descriptions.

params.name: value_search
params.description: Search blocks by value. If provided, returns blocks whose value matches the search query. This is a full-text search on block values.

params.name: connected_to_agents_count_gt
params.description: Filter blocks by the number of connected agents. If provided, returns blocks that have more than this number of connected agents.

params.name: connected_to_agents_count_lt
params.description: Filter blocks by the number of connected agents. If provided, returns blocks that have less than this number of connected agents.

params.name: connected_to_agents_count_eq
params.description: Filter blocks by the exact number of connected agents. If provided, returns blocks that have exactly this number of connected agents.
